summary.en: Israel is conducting air and drone strikes in southern Lebanon that have killed a Hezbollah operative, wounded another, and killed a civilian on a motorcycle while wounding a second. Hezbollah is responding with artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. Israeli forces have also built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel utfører luft- og droneram i Sør-Lebanon som har drept en Hezbollah-operativ, såret en annen, og drept en sivil på motorsykkel mens en annen ble såret. Hezbollah svarer med artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og har begynt å dele ut sine første kontantutbetalinger til krigsrammede og fordrivne familier. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Israelske styrker har også bygget en ny vei i bufferområdet i Shebaa-dalen. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
